metadata.image-description: In a high-tech workspace bathed in blue hues and electric shadows, a woman with vibrant magenta hair intently works at a glowing, map-like interface surrounded by a ring of dynamic data screens and sci-fi engineering tools. Her posture conveys focus and determination as she drafts or analyzes complex information on the illuminated surface. The environment is both cluttered and purposeful, a visual symphony of wires, mechanical limbs, and interactive holograms, embodying the convergence of creativity, technology, and exploration. The scene blends cyberpunk aesthetics with narrative-driven futurism, evoking themes of prompt engineering, space navigation, and digital craftsmanship.

coverImagePrompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: AI.Tedt.org artifact gallery cover
Artifact kind: Prompt Template File
Primary request: a stack of weighted optical layers combines subject, medium, lighting, composition, and atmosphere into one precise surreal image tableau
Scene/backdrop: warm paper optical workbench with a calm slate-to-navy background
Subject: one sculptural sequence of overlapping cyan and navy glass lenses of varied thickness, aligning disparate tactile fragments into a single dreamlike landscape panel; one orange counterweight fine-tunes the stack
Style/medium: premium tactile editorial illustration with optical glass, paper diorama, and dimensional studio detail
Composition/framing: exact 16:10 landscape; oblique view through the layered lens stack toward one coherent scene; crop-safe focal subject; no essential detail in the outer 8%; legible at approximately 290-pixel card width
Lighting/mood: experimental, exacting, imaginative, restrained luminous depth
Color palette: warm paper #F8F6F0, slate #101820, navy #00446F, cyan #00A9E0, sparing orange #E86027
Materials/textures: beveled glass, folded paper terrain, matte enamel rings, subtle vellum haze
Constraints: all panels and controls unmarked; no interface or parameter notation; original composition; no text, pseudo-writing, letters, numbers, product UI, vendor logos, trademarks, watermarks, paws, paw imagery, paw logos, cats, cat silhouettes, or Microsoft Fluent styling
Avoid: provider branding, command lines, camera bodies, generic image grids, glowing brains, neon rainbow gradients, clutter
